children: GSX 26 Presence Include Education Session on AI-Orchestrated Operations, SARA Assess at Circadian Risk Booth 1747, ROSA at DSI Security Services Booth 2612
Detroit, Michigan--(Newsfile Corp. - September 1, 2026) -
(OTCID: AITX) (the "Company"), a developer and operator of AI-driven security and productivity solutions for enterprise clients, along with its wholly owned subsidiary,

(RAD), today announced that RAD will participate in Global Security Exchange (GSX) 2026, taking place September 14 through 16 at the Georgia World Congress Center in Atlanta, through a session in the show's education program and product demonstrations hosted in two partner booths.
Artist’s depiction of RAD’s GSX 2026 presence across the show floor.
To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:
Steve Reinharz, CEO/CTO and founder of AITX and RAD, and Darlnita Derico, Manager, RVM Client Success at RAD, will present "

params.linkText: Operator 2.0: Staffing and Skills for AI-Orchestrated Security Operations

children: " on Tuesday, September 15 at 2:45 PM ET in room B306. The session examines how the security operator role changes when AI handles first-pass detection and engagement, covering oversight, approvals, escalation triggers and exception handling; the skill gaps and training paths those responsibilities create; and how staffing, handoffs and performance measurement can be redesigned around exceptions and outcomes rather than headcount and hours.

"We're taking the education stage, a SARA demonstration in Circadian Risk's booth, and a ROSA™ running in DSI's booth. Our onsite team and partners are looking forward to engaging with attendees on our mobile patrol vehicle ROAMEO™, our stationary solutions lead by ROSA and RIO™," said Steve Reinharz, CEO/CTO and founder of AITX and RAD. "Hardware, software, integration with partners, there is so much going on, come see it all at GSX."

RAD team members will also be on hand at two partner locations on the show floor. Circadian Risk will demonstrate SARA™ Assess in booth 1747, the jointly developed solution that connects SARA's agentic AI to Circadian Risk's physical risk intelligence platform to verify connected security controls and initiate corrective action. DSI Security Services will showcase a ROSA stationary security unit in booth 2612. RAD is not exhibiting under its own booth at GSX 2026.

RAD's presence at GSX 2026 reflects how its solutions reach the market. The Company's agentic AI operates inside monitoring platforms, risk intelligence systems and dealer operations that customers already run, which means RAD technology reaches some end users through partners as well as directly. Circadian Risk and DSI Security Services are demonstrating that model on the show floor, while the education session addresses what changes for the people who operate these systems once AI is doing the first pass.

Security leaders attending GSX 2026 are invited to attend the Operator 2.0 session on Tuesday, September 15, and to visit Circadian Risk in booth 1747 to see RAD solutions in operation and meet with RAD team members on site. Attendees who would like to arrange time with the RAD team during the show can request a meeting.
About Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions, Inc. (AITX)

AITX is a developer and provider of artificial intelligence-based solutions that empower organizations to gain new insight, solve complex challenges and drive operational efficiency. Through its family of companies, including PURSUON, Inc. (formerly RAD-M), Robotic Assistance Devices, Inc. (RAD-I), Robotic Assistance Devices Residential (RAD-R), Robotic Assistance Devices Group (RAD-G), and Robotic Assistance Devices Lanka (Private) Limited (RAD Lanka), AITX develops and delivers a broad range of AI-driven technologies and services designed to transform security, automation, and operational workflows across multiple industries.

Through its primary subsidiary, RAD-I, AITX is redefining the nearly $50 billion U.S. security and guarding services industry1 with its AI-driven Solutions-as-a-Service model. RAD solutions are specifically designed to deliver cost savings of between 35% and 80% compared to traditional manned security and monitoring, utilizing a suite of stationary and mobile autonomous systems that complement, and in many cases replace, human personnel in environments better suited for machines. All RAD technologies, AI-based analytics and software platforms are developed in-house.
All of RAD's solutions are designed to integrate with leading industry platforms and workflows, including an integration with Immix®, a provider of central station and remote monitoring software.

The Company's operations and internal controls have been validated through successful completion of its SOC 2 Type 2 audit, reinforcing its credibility with enterprise and government clients that require rigorous data protection and compliance standards.

AITX is led by Steve Reinharz, CEO/CTO and founder of the Company and all subsidiaries, who brings decades of experience in the security services industry. The broader AITX leadership and its subsidiaries draw on deep expertise across security, law enforcement, and robotics innovation, supporting the Company's ability to deliver practical and scalable solutions.
The Company's solutions are deployed across a wide range of industries including enterprises, government, transportation, critical infrastructure, education, and healthcare.

To learn more, visit www.aitx.ai, www.radsecurity.com, www.pursuon.com, www.radgroup.ai, www.saramonitoring.ai, www.radlightmyway.com, and www.stevereinharz.com, or follow Steve Reinharz on X @SteveReinharz.
